constraints.mask_statement: Convert only the resolved Tumor/Other tissue source to Stroma, never use Normal epithelium as a generic source, preserve all other pixels, and satisfy the area budget.
generation_handoff: Render true compatible stroma; a coarse target ID alone does not establish desmoplastic histology.
known_limitations: Profiles without a Stroma class cannot use this primitive.

constraints.mask_statement: Start from one existing source-to-Stroma interface, remain inside its band, and reject remote islands, splits, merges, holes, prohibited overlap, or unnatural depth/shape.
